title: [RPG Design Guides] An Analysis of the Silent Protagonist

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】無口主人公の考察
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] An Analysis of the Silent Protagonist

blocks.source: 『無口主人公』とは喋らず、セリフの無い主人公のことである。これはＤＱシリーズを始めとした多数のＲＰＧで採用されている定番の主人公形式である。今回はこの無口主人公について、考察してみたい。
blocks.translation: A “silent protagonist” is a protagonist who does not speak and has no lines. This is a classic protagonist format used in many RPGs, beginning with the Dragon Quest series. This time, I would like to examine the silent protagonist.

blocks.source: セリフがないからといって、必ずしも没個性とは限らないことに注意して欲しい。また、選択肢の中身については、セリフがあることも珍しくない。仲間に個性が設定されているかどうかでも、かなり雰囲気が変わってくる。
blocks.translation: Please note that having no lines does not necessarily mean lacking individuality. Also, the contents of dialogue choices are not always without lines. The overall atmosphere changes considerably depending on whether the party members have distinct personalities.

blocks.source: 目次
blocks.translation: Table of Contents

blocks.source: 無口主人公の作品例
blocks.translation: Examples of Works with Silent Protagonists

blocks.source: 参考に無口主人公の作品例を挙げてみよう。
blocks.translation: For reference, let us look at some examples of works with silent protagonists.

blocks.source: ウィザードリィ
blocks.translation: Wizardry

blocks.source: 主人公も仲間にも全くといってよいほど個性や背景が設定されておらず、名前・職業等も自分で選択することができる。一応、迷宮に探索に来た冒険者という設定だけはあるが、完全に近い無個性と言える。
blocks.translation: Neither the protagonist nor the party members have any real individuality or background established, and even their names and classes can be chosen by the player. They are ostensibly adventurers who have come to explore a dungeon, but they can be said to have almost no individuality at all.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest

blocks.source: ＤＱ１の時代は、主人公には『勇者の子孫』といった最低限の背景が設定されているだけだった。名前のみを自分で決めることができる。
blocks.translation: In the era of Dragon Quest I, the protagonist had only a minimal background, such as being a “descendant of the Luminary.” The player could choose only the protagonist’s name.

blocks.source: ＤＱ２では、仲間が追加されたが、セリフは控えめであり、主人公の個性を浮かび上がらせるようなものでは無かった。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest II, party members were added, but their lines were restrained and did not bring the protagonist’s individuality to the forefront.

blocks.source: ＤＱ３に至って、徐々に主人公の背景が濃くなってくる。『英雄の息子』として、主人公は旅立つことになり、ゲーム終盤にその設定が活かされることになる。仲間も基本的に喋らないので、主人公とのやり取りはない。その個性はほぼプレイヤーの想像に任される形になる。
blocks.translation: By Dragon Quest III, the protagonist’s background gradually became more substantial. The protagonist sets out on a journey as the “son of a hero,” and this setting is put to use toward the end of the game. Since the party members also basically do not speak, there are no exchanges with the protagonist. Their individuality is left almost entirely to the player’s imagination.

blocks.source: ＦＣ版のカンダタ２戦目のイベントで、主人公（正確には先頭のキャラ）が喋るのは黒歴史。
blocks.translation: The protagonist (more precisely, the character in the lead position) speaking during the second encounter with Kandar in the Famicom version is best left in the series’ dark history.

blocks.source: 「あいつは わたしたちに
blocks.translation: “Leave him to us

blocks.source: まかせて！ はやく にげるんだ！」
blocks.translation: to handle! Run away, quickly!”

blocks.source: ＤＱ４では『育った村を魔族に滅ぼされた悲劇の勇者』として、主人公は旅立つことになる。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest IV, the protagonist sets out on a journey as “a tragic Luminary whose hometown was destroyed by demons.”

blocks.source: ＤＱ５では主人公の出生や結婚等、自身の人生が物語の中心に据えられている。セリフこそないものの主人公は確たる背景を持った１つのキャラクターとして、設定されていることが分かる。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest V, the protagonist’s own life—including their birth and marriage—is placed at the center of the story. Although the protagonist has no lines, it is clear that they are established as a fully realized character with a definite background.

blocks.source: シリーズが進むに連れて、個性的な仲間達も主人公に関わってくるようになる。
blocks.translation: As the series progresses, distinctive party members also become increasingly involved with the protagonist.

blocks.source: 特にＤＱ７の『マリベル』は主人公に対して話しかけることが多く、主人公も人間関係の輪に含まれていることがはっきり分かる。
blocks.translation: In particular, Maribel in Dragon Quest VII often speaks to the protagonist, making it clear that the protagonist is also part of the circle of relationships.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８の『ヤンガス』に至っては、主人公に命を助けられたことをきっかけに主人公を兄貴分と慕うようになる。
blocks.translation: By the time of Yangus in Dragon Quest VIII, he comes to look up to the protagonist as an older-brother figure after the protagonist saves his life.

blocks.source: ＤＱ９では、仲間が喋らない等、ＤＱ３の頃に近い雰囲気に戻る。主人公の職業や容姿が設定できることによって、今まで以上に『主人公＝プレイヤー』の構図を強調している。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest IX, the series returns to an atmosphere closer to that of Dragon Quest III, with party members who do not speak and so on. Allowing the player to customize the protagonist’s class and appearance emphasizes the structure of “the protagonist = the player” more strongly than ever.

blocks.source: シリーズを通して、選択肢の内容が『はい』『いいえ』に限られていることも、特徴として忘れてはならない。ただし、ＤＱ８のような路線で、主人公の個性化が行われるならば、この伝統の選択肢もそろそろ限界なんじゃないかと個人的には踏んでいる。
blocks.translation: One feature of the series that should not be overlooked is that the choices are limited to “Yes” and “No.” However, if the protagonist continues to be given individuality along the lines of Dragon Quest VIII, I personally suspect that this traditional choice system is nearing its limit.

blocks.source: ペルソナ
blocks.translation: Persona

blocks.source: 無口主人公としては、最も個性的なのが、このペルソナシリーズ。元々、源流の女神転生シリーズでは、無個性型の無口主人公が主流だった。このペルソナシリーズでは無口主人公こそ受け継いでいるが、無個性ではない。
blocks.translation: Of all silent protagonists, the Persona series has perhaps the most individuality. Originally, in the Megami Tensei series from which it evolved, silent protagonists with no individuality were the norm. The Persona series inherited the silent protagonist, but not the lack of individuality.

blocks.source: 選択肢に特徴を持たせて、個性を強調したり、仲間から好意や信頼を寄せられたりと、随所に存在感を発生する。また、容姿や選択肢の内容、仲間との会話からクールな性格を漂わせているのが特徴。作品によっては、一人称（大抵は『俺』）やクセ等も設定されている。
blocks.translation: The choices are distinctive, emphasizing the protagonist’s individuality, while the protagonist also earns the affection and trust of their companions, creating a strong presence throughout the game. Another characteristic is the cool personality conveyed through the protagonist’s appearance, choice contents, and conversations with companions. Depending on the title, even the protagonist’s first-person pronoun (usually “ore”) and mannerisms may be established.

blocks.source: ペルソナ２罪では、主人公『周防達哉』は過去の出来事から無口な性格になったと説明されている。その続編、『罰』では、主人公が交代、達哉が喋る仲間キャラに降格（？）した代わりに、前作でヒロイン格だった『天野舞耶』が無口主人公になるという異例の展開。なお、舞耶は前作で元気な性格だったので、物凄く違和感がある。
blocks.translation: In Persona 2: Innocent Sin, it is explained that the protagonist, Tatsuya Suou, became taciturn because of events in the past. In its sequel, Persona 2: Eternal Punishment, the protagonist changes, and Tatsuya is demoted (?) to a speaking party member; instead, Maya Amano, who had been the heroine figure in the previous game, becomes the silent protagonist. Maya had an energetic personality in the previous game, so the change feels extremely strange.

blocks.source: ペルソナ３では「どうでもいい」、４では「落ち着け」というように、選択肢の中に頻出するものがある。これを主人公の口癖とも解釈することができる。
blocks.translation: Some choices appear frequently, such as “Whatever” in Persona 3 and “Calm down” in Persona 4. These can also be interpreted as the protagonist’s verbal habits.

blocks.source: その他の例
blocks.translation: Other Examples

blocks.source: ポケモン、女神転生、マザー、ＦＥ風花雪月、ブレスオブファイア１～４、幻想水滸伝、クロノトリガー、クロノクロス、聖剣伝説ＬＯＭ、バハムートラグーン、ワイルドアームズ１、桃太郎伝説、大貝獣物語、ヘラクレスの栄光……等々。
blocks.translation: Pokémon, Megami Tensei, MOTHER, Fire Emblem: Three Houses, Breath of Fire I–IV, Suikoden, Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Legend of Mana, Bahamut Lagoon, Wild Arms I, Momotaro Dentetsu, The Great Battle of the Shell Monsters, Glory of Hercules, and so on.

blocks.source: 全体的な傾向として、シリーズが進む毎に、無口主人公であっても、個性や設定背景が濃くなっていく傾向にある。中にはブレスオブファイアやワイルドアームズのように、後の作品で喋る主人公になる場合も。
blocks.translation: As a general trend, even when protagonists remain silent, their individuality and established backgrounds tend to become more substantial with each installment. In some cases, such as Breath of Fire and Wild Arms, the protagonist even becomes a speaking character in later titles.

blocks.source: 無口主人公の長所
blocks.translation: Advantages of Silent Protagonists

blocks.source: 『キャラクターとしての主人公』に余計なセリフを喋らせないことで、『主人公＝プレイヤー』であることを強調し、感情移入度を高める。プレイヤーが思ってもいない言動を主人公が取ることで、感情移入を妨げる事態を避けることができる。
blocks.translation: By not having the “protagonist as a character” speak unnecessary lines, the game emphasizes that “the protagonist = the player” and increases immersion. It also avoids situations in which the protagonist says or does something the player would never think or do, hindering immersion.

blocks.source: 主人公が喋らないことによって、会話が短くなりテンポが良くなる事も重要な長所だ。主人公も仲間も一切、喋らないような作品の場合はこれが顕著となる。
blocks.translation: Another important advantage is that having the protagonist remain silent shortens conversations and improves the pacing. This is especially noticeable in works where neither the protagonist nor the party members speak at all.

blocks.source: また、主人公に喋らせないことで、仲間の個性を強調する効果がある。シナリオ重視の作品において、プレイヤーに仲間の魅力を伝えたいという場合も有効だ。
blocks.translation: Having the protagonist remain silent also emphasizes the individuality of the party members. This is effective in story-focused works that aim to convey the appeal of the companions to the player.

blocks.source: 逆転の発想で、無口であること自体を主人公の個性として差別化することもできる。なんせ、どれだけ登場人物の多い物語においても、他と性格がかぶることはまずないからだ。
blocks.translation: As a reversal of this idea, the protagonist’s silence itself can be used to differentiate them as an individual. After all, no matter how many characters a story has, it is highly unlikely that another character will share exactly the same personality.

blocks.source: 無口主人公の短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages of Silent Protagonists

blocks.source: その特性上、無口主人公は自分の発言によって物語を牽引することはできない。例えば「魔王を倒さなければ世界が滅ぶ。だから俺達で魔王を倒す！」というような発言をして、プレイヤーへ目的を伝えることはできない。
blocks.translation: By their nature, silent protagonists cannot drive the story through their own words. For example, they cannot tell the player the objective by saying something like, “The world will be destroyed unless we defeat the Demon King. So we’ll defeat him ourselves!”

blocks.source: 他の仲間に同様の発言をさせるか、王様などの登場人物から「魔王を倒してくれ！」というように指示を受ける必要がある。
blocks.translation: Another party member must say something similar, or a character such as a king must give them an instruction like, “Please defeat the Demon King!”

blocks.source: そのため、主人公でありながら、他の仲間に同調したり、指示を受けたりする形で行動しがちになる。自然『お使いイベント』と揶揄されるようなイベントも多くなる。
blocks.translation: As a result, despite being the protagonist, they tend to act by going along with the other party members or following instructions. Naturally, more events arise that can be derisively described as “fetch quests.”

blocks.source: また、ＤＱ３や９のように仲間も一切喋らない作品なら大きな問題はない。が、そうでない場合は進行上で仲間同士での会話が多くなる場合がある。その際に、主人公が仲間の輪から疎外された結果、存在感が希薄となり、空気主人公と揶揄されてしまうハメになる。
blocks.translation: There is no major problem in works like Dragon Quest III and IX, where the party members do not speak at all. Otherwise, however, the party members may have many conversations among themselves as the story progresses. If the protagonist is excluded from the group as a result, their presence fades, and they end up being derisively called a “background protagonist.”

blocks.source: 無口主人公とは相性の悪い主人公設定・物語があることも考慮しなくてはならない。例えば、主人公が歴戦の戦士で、過去の知り合いが多数登場するような物語だった場合などだ。
blocks.translation: One must also consider that some protagonist settings and stories do not work well with a silent protagonist. For example, this could be a story in which the protagonist is a veteran warrior and many acquaintances from their past appear.

blocks.source: 物語中盤で初登場した人物に、いきなり知り合いであるかのように声をかけられたら、「主人公＝自分」を前提として考えていたプレイヤーはとまどうかもしれない。
blocks.translation: If someone appearing for the first time halfway through the story suddenly addresses the protagonist as though they already know each other, players who had been assuming “the protagonist = me” might be confused.

blocks.source: 無口主人公における技法
blocks.translation: Techniques for Silent Protagonists

blocks.source: 無口主人公には大きな長所があるが、同時に大きな短所も存在することが分かったと思う。そこで、短所を補うため、無口主人公でも物語をうまく進行する方法や、存在感を出していく方法を考えていきたい。
blocks.translation: I hope it is now clear that silent protagonists have major advantages, but also major disadvantages. Therefore, I would like to consider ways to move the story forward effectively and give the protagonist a strong presence even while keeping them silent, thereby compensating for these disadvantages.

blocks.source: 色の付かない設定を与える
blocks.translation: Give Them an Uncolored Background

blocks.source: 先に書いた通り『歴戦の戦士』などの濃い人物設定と無口主人公とは相性が悪い。そのため、物語開始時点では、なるべく色の付かない設定を当てはめる必要がある。やはり、十代後半の若者などが主人公とされることが多い。
blocks.translation: As I mentioned earlier, a strong character setting such as “veteran warrior” does not work well with a silent protagonist. Therefore, at the beginning of the story, it is necessary to give the protagonist a background that is as unrestrictive as possible. This is why protagonists are often young people in their late teens.

blocks.source: また、色が付かないという意味では、記憶喪失の設定とも相性がよく、合わせて使用されることが多い。（ヘラクレスの栄光シリーズ等）
blocks.translation: In the sense that it leaves the character undefined, amnesia also works well with a silent protagonist and is often used in combination with one (as in the Glory of Hercules series, among others).

blocks.source: 主人公特権を与える
blocks.translation: Give Them Protagonist Privileges

blocks.source: 強大な能力。世界の命運を左右するような物でも。
blocks.translation: Powerful abilities—even ones capable of determining the fate of the world.

blocks.source: 地位。国王・王子、伝説の勇者など。
blocks.translation: Status, such as being a king, prince, or legendary Luminary.

blocks.source: 関係性。ヒロインやラスボス等の主要人物と強固な因縁を設定する。
blocks.translation: Relationships. Establish strong connections with key characters such as the heroine and final boss.

blocks.source: 幻想水滸伝１～２では、主人公が成り行きで『強大な紋章の力』を手に入れたあげく、『軍の指導者』として担がれる。というような流れが序盤に展開される。『強大な能力』と『地位』といった特権を主人公に付けることで、存在感を出しているわけである。
blocks.translation: In Suikoden I–II, the protagonist happens to acquire the power of a powerful Rune and is then elevated to the position of military leader. This sequence of events unfolds early in the story. Giving the protagonist privileges such as powerful abilities and status helps establish their presence.

blocks.source: 先に述べた通り、無口主人公は自分の発言によって物語を牽引することはできない。
blocks.translation: As mentioned earlier, a silent protagonist cannot drive the story through their own dialogue.

blocks.source: そのため、単なる村人のような設定では「なぜ、主人公が強大なラスボスと戦うのか？」といった動機をスムーズにプレイヤーへ理解させることは難しい。上記のような主人公特権を設定することで説得力を出そう。
blocks.translation: Therefore, with a setting in which the protagonist is merely an ordinary villager, it is difficult to smoothly convey to the player the motivation behind questions such as, “Why is the protagonist fighting the powerful final boss?” Give the protagonist the kinds of privileges described above to make the premise more convincing.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: ラスボスを倒すには、主人公が持つ特殊能力が必要。
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s special ability is necessary to defeat the final boss.

blocks.source: 主人公は王子として、自国を脅かすラスボスと戦う。
blocks.translation: As a prince, the protagonist fights the final boss threatening their country.

blocks.source: 幼馴染のヒロインを助けるには、ラスボスを倒さなければならない。
blocks.translation: The protagonist must defeat the final boss to save their childhood friend, the heroine.

blocks.source: という具合である。
blocks.translation: That is the general idea.

blocks.source: 選択肢を用いる
blocks.translation: Use Choices

blocks.source: 選択肢を掲示することで、主人公が会話に参加しているという空気を出す。選択肢に応じて、どのような変化をもたらすかがポイント。単に会話内容に変化を付けるだけの場合もあれば、後の展開に重大な影響を与えることも。
blocks.translation: Presenting choices creates the impression that the protagonist is participating in the conversation. The key is what changes occur depending on the choice. Sometimes only the dialogue changes, while in other cases the choice may have a major impact on later developments.

blocks.source: 「はい」「いいえ」の様に無個性なものを用いるか、ペルソナシリーズの様に個性的な選択肢を用意するかでも、主人公に対する印象が変化する。作品に合ったものを考案しよう。
blocks.translation: The impression of the protagonist changes depending on whether you use impersonal choices such as “Yes” and “No” or provide distinctive choices like those in the Persona series. Come up with choices that suit your game.

blocks.source: 好感度システムのようなものを採用する作品も多いが、ギャルゲーチックになるのが好き嫌いの分かれるところ。どうするかは作品のテーマに合わせて考えよう。
blocks.translation: Many games adopt systems such as an affinity system, but whether the result feels too much like a dating sim is a matter of personal preference. Decide what to do based on the game’s themes.

blocks.source: ジェスチャーや感情記号を用いる
blocks.translation: Use Gestures and Emotional Symbols

blocks.source: 無口主人公だからといって、常にイベント中、無反応で棒立ちでは、違和感を拭い切れない。何より、いてもいなくてもいい存在に見えてしまう。
blocks.translation: Even for a silent protagonist, it feels unnatural if they simply stand there without reacting throughout every event. Above all, they end up seeming like someone who could just as well not be there.

blocks.source: そこで「頷く」「首を振る」「手を振る」等のジェスチャーや「！」「…」「♪」等の感情記号を活用することで、主人公が置いてけぼりにならないようにする。また、最低限のリアクションをさせることで、話を円滑にすすめる。
blocks.translation: Use gestures such as nodding, shaking their head, and waving, as well as emotional symbols such as “!”, “…”, and “♪”, so that the protagonist does not get left behind. Giving them at least minimal reactions also helps keep the story moving smoothly.

blocks.source: 例えば、「仲間の命が危ない！ 助けよう！」というような会話において、常識的に考えて主人公が否定的な態度を取ることはありえない。
blocks.translation: For example, in a conversation like “Our friend’s life is in danger! Let’s save them!”, it would be inconceivable for the protagonist to take a negative attitude from a common-sense perspective.

blocks.source: このように「選択肢を掲示したくない」あるいは「するまでもない」場合は「頷く」の動作で主人公に勝手に承諾させてしまおう。選択肢を出すよりもテンポ良く話を進めることができる。
blocks.translation: In cases where you do not want to present a choice, or where one is unnecessary, have the protagonist automatically agree through a nod. This lets the conversation move along more smoothly than presenting a choice.

blocks.source: 自発的に行動させる
blocks.translation: Have the Protagonist Act Voluntarily

blocks.source: 物語としては、ある程度、無口主人公にも自発的に行動してもらわなければ進まない。ジェスチャーや感情記号程度では足りないという場合は、もっと積極的に行動してもらう。
blocks.translation: As a story, the game cannot progress unless the silent protagonist takes some initiative. If gestures and emotional symbols are not enough, have them act more proactively.

blocks.source: 例としては、前述したＤＱ８における、主人公がヤンガスを助ける回想シーンが挙げられる。このシーンの流れを説明すると、以下のようになっている。
blocks.translation: One example is the flashback scene in DQ8 mentioned earlier, in which the protagonist saves Yangus. The scene proceeds as follows.

blocks.source: 当時、山賊をしていたヤンガスが、主人公とその主トロデに対して脅迫を行う。
blocks.translation: Yangus, who was a bandit at the time, threatens the protagonist and their master, Trode.

blocks.source: ヤンガスは武器を振り回すが、足元の吊橋を壊し、崖の下に落ちそうになる。
blocks.translation: Yangus swings his weapon around, breaks the suspension bridge beneath him, and nearly falls off the cliff.

blocks.source: トロデは、ヤンガスを見捨てるように言う。
blocks.translation: Trode tells the protagonist to abandon Yangus.

blocks.source: しかし、それを無視して主人公はヤンガスを助ける。
blocks.translation: However, the protagonist ignores him and saves Yangus.

blocks.source: これは『主人公＝プレイヤー』の等式を徹底するＤＱシリーズとしては異例の展開である。主人公がこれだけ自発的に行動することは珍しく、個人的にとても興味深いと思った。
blocks.translation: This is an unusual development for the Dragon Quest series, which consistently follows the equation “the protagonist = the player.” It is rare for the protagonist to act so voluntarily, and I personally found it very interesting.

blocks.source: 一連の流れの中で主人公は表情の変化こそあるものの、当然セリフは発しない。プレイヤーの意思を一切介さないまま、ヤンガスを助けることを決断し、行動に移す。
blocks.translation: Although the protagonist’s expression changes during this sequence of events, they naturally do not speak a single line. Without involving the player’s will at all, they decide to save Yangus and put that decision into action.

blocks.source: このように無口主人公に対して、自発的に行動させてしまうのも１つの手だ。ただし、余りにも勝手な行動を取らせてしまうと、プレイヤーの心は離れてしまう。人助け等の常識的・良識的な行動を取らせることで、プレイヤーの納得を得られるようにしたい。
blocks.translation: Having a silent protagonist act voluntarily in this way is one possible approach. However, if you make them act too arbitrarily, the player may lose their connection with the character. Try to have them take common-sense, morally sound actions, such as helping someone, so that the player can accept their decisions.

blocks.source: 相棒を作る
blocks.translation: Create a Partner

blocks.source: 無口主人公の作品において、ストーリー進行を円滑に行うには『相棒』を作る方法がある。ここで言う相棒とは、無口主人公に代わって、セリフを喋る役目を担ったキャラクターのことを指す。
blocks.translation: In a game with a silent protagonist, one way to keep the story moving smoothly is to create a “partner.” Here, a partner refers to a character whose role is to speak lines in place of the silent protagonist.

blocks.source: 「アイツ 何て悪い奴なんだ！ 俺達で懲らしめてやろうぜ！」というような感想を述べさせながら、プレイヤーの行動を誘導してしまおう。
blocks.translation: Guide the player’s actions by having the partner make comments such as, “What a terrible person! Let’s teach them a lesson!”

blocks.source: また「わっ！ 虫眼鏡で太陽を見てはいけないって学校で習ったでしょう。ボス！」というように、主人公の行動や選択肢に対してリアクションを返すのも役目である。
blocks.translation: Another role is to react to the protagonist’s actions and choices, saying things like, “Whoa! You learned at school not to look at the sun through a magnifying glass, remember? Boss!”

blocks.source: ポイントは主人公に対して、語りかけるような口調にすること。主人公の意向を形だけでも、伺うようにすることで、主人公の存在感が希薄にならないようにしていこう。
blocks.translation: The key is to have the partner speak as though addressing the protagonist. Even if only in form, asking about the protagonist’s wishes helps prevent their presence from fading into the background.

blocks.source: 相棒は物語の大半において、主人公に同行するキャラクターである必要がある。ＤＱ９の『サンディ』、風来のシレンの『コッパ』等、必ずしも戦闘に参加するキャラクターである必要はない。
blocks.translation: For most of the story, the partner needs to be a character who accompanies the protagonist. They do not necessarily need to participate in battles, as with Sandy from DQ9 or Koppa from Shiren the Wanderer.

blocks.source: また、必ずしも特定の１人である必要はない。主人公との関係性から、上記のような反応をすることに違和感のないキャラクターならばＯＫ。
blocks.translation: The partner does not necessarily have to be one specific person, either. Any character whose relationship with the protagonist makes the kinds of reactions described above feel natural will work.

blocks.source: 仲間や敵に主人公を意識させる
blocks.translation: Make Allies and Enemies Pay Attention to the Protagonist

blocks.source: 「仲間同士の会話」「仲間と敵との会話」に置き去りにされた結果、主人公の存在感が希薄となる。というのは、無口主人公における大きな悩みである。仲間の個性が強い作品程、この懸念は強くなる。
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s presence can fade into the background as a result of being left out of conversations between allies or conversations between allies and enemies. This is a major challenge with silent protagonists. The stronger the personalities of the allies, the greater this concern becomes.

blocks.source: そこで、主人公に対して『好意』『親愛』『敵視』等、何らかの形で強い意識を向けるキャラクターを作ってみよう。こうすることで、主人公を物語の輪に入れて、存在感を出していきたい。
blocks.translation: Try creating characters who show the protagonist strong interest in some way, such as affection, fondness, or hostility. This brings the protagonist into the story’s circle and helps establish their presence.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: 主人公に好意を向けるヒロイン。
blocks.translation: A heroine who has feelings for the protagonist.

blocks.source: 主人公を兄貴として慕う、弟分・妹分キャラ。実の弟妹も当然ＯＫ。
blocks.translation: A younger-brother or younger-sister type who looks up to the protagonist as an older brother. Actual younger siblings work too, of course.

blocks.source: 主人公を主君と仰ぐ召し使い。
blocks.translation: A servant who reveres the protagonist as their lord.

blocks.source: 主人公を頼りにする親友。
blocks.translation: A close friend who relies on the protagonist.

blocks.source: 主人公をライバル視する敵キャラ。
blocks.translation: An enemy who regards the protagonist as a rival.

blocks.source: 『相棒』と兼業させるのもオススメの方法だ。
blocks.translation: Having this character also serve as the “partner” is another recommended approach.

blocks.source: 主人公の株を奪うキャラクターを作らない
blocks.translation: Do Not Create Characters Who Steal the Protagonist’s Spotlight

blocks.source: これは後ろ向きの発想になるが、主人公の株を奪いかねないようなキャラクターは最初から作らないようにしてしまおう。
blocks.translation: This is a somewhat negative approach, but simply avoid creating characters from the outset who might steal the protagonist’s spotlight.

blocks.source: 主人公の立場をおびやかすようなキャラクターの特徴。
blocks.translation: Characteristics of characters who threaten the protagonist’s position.

blocks.source: 主人公と性別が同じ。
blocks.translation: The same gender as the protagonist.

blocks.source: 身分、立場、年齢等が主人公より上。
blocks.translation: Higher in status, position, age, or similar respects than the protagonist.

blocks.source: 主人公以上にストーリーの根幹に関わる設定を持つ。
blocks.translation: Has a backstory that is even more central to the story than the protagonist's.

blocks.source: 容姿端麗。
blocks.translation: Good-looking.

blocks.source: モテる。特に主人公よりも、ヒロインと仲が良いと鉄板。
blocks.translation: Popular. In particular, having a closer relationship with the heroine than the protagonist does is a sure formula.

blocks.source: 高い能力を持つ。
blocks.translation: Highly capable.

blocks.source: 頼り甲斐がある。
blocks.translation: Reliable.

blocks.source: 頭が良い。
blocks.translation: Intelligent.

blocks.source: 人当たりが良い。
blocks.translation: Pleasant and personable.

blocks.source: 行動力がある。
blocks.translation: Proactive.

blocks.source: 以上のような特徴を多く併せ持つキャラクターは、主人公の株を奪いかねない。というか、そんなキャラクターを作るなら、そっちを主人公にすべきだろう。一部の特徴を満たすキャラクターは当然いても良いが、パーティの中心を奪われないように、何らかの欠点を作っておこう。
blocks.translation: A character who combines many of the above traits may end up stealing the protagonist's spotlight. In fact, if you're going to create such a character, they should probably be the protagonist instead. It's perfectly fine to have characters who possess some of these traits, but give them some kind of flaw so they don't take the central role in the party.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example...

blocks.source: 物語の目的に関わる重要人物だが、性格はヘタレ。
blocks.translation: An important character involved in the story's objective, but a coward at heart.

blocks.source: 切れ者だが、偏屈で人当たりが悪い。
blocks.translation: Sharp-witted, but eccentric and unpleasant to be around.

blocks.source: 行動力はあるが、無鉄砲で失敗も多い。
blocks.translation: Full of initiative, but reckless and often unsuccessful.

blocks.source: 途中で裏切ったり離脱したりする。
blocks.translation: Betrays the party or leaves it partway through.

blocks.source: これは無口主人公に限らず、主人公全般にも言えることでもある。ＦＦ１２における『ヴァン』に対する『アーシェ』や『バルフレア』がその典型。無口主人公だと自己主張の機会が少ないので、より気を付けたい。
blocks.translation: This applies not only to silent protagonists, but to protagonists in general. Ashe and Balthier in relation to Vaan in FF12 are classic examples. Since silent protagonists have fewer opportunities to assert themselves, you need to be especially careful.

blocks.source: 無口主人公の向き不向き（2023/12/05）
blocks.translation: When Silent Protagonists Work (2023/12/05)

blocks.source: 作風によって、無口主人公には向き不向きがある。
blocks.translation: Depending on the style of the work, silent protagonists may or may not be a good fit.

blocks.source: 特に注意したいのは、無口主人公かつ仲間がよく喋る作品だ。
blocks.translation: Particular caution is needed for works with a silent protagonist and highly talkative companions.

blocks.source: 仲間同士の会話中心で物語が進んでしまうと、主人公の存在価値が疑わしくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: If the story progresses mainly through conversations between companions, the protagonist's value and purpose may come into question.

blocks.source: ＤＱ１１やペルソナシリーズ、ＦＥ風花雪月といった作品を観察してみると、無口主人公を立てるために相当な配慮をしていることが分かるだろう。
blocks.translation: If you examine works such as DQ11, the Persona series, and FE: Three Houses, you'll see that they take considerable care to highlight their silent protagonists.

blocks.source: 主人公を唯一無二の選ばれし者にしたり、仲間との一対一の交流イベントを用意したり、さらには恋愛要素を導入したりと、あの手この手で盛り立てている。
blocks.translation: They use every method imaginable to build up the protagonist: making them the one-and-only chosen one, providing one-on-one interaction events with companions, and even introducing romantic elements.

blocks.source: なお、仲間がよく喋るという点ではＤＱ７も同じだが、あちらは大きな問題にはならない。
blocks.translation: DQ7 also has highly talkative companions, but it doesn't become a major problem.

blocks.source: ＤＱ７では原則、プレイヤーが仲間に話しかけることで会話をする仕組みになっているからだ。ストーリー上で仲間同士が自発的に会話をするシーンは、極めて限られている。
blocks.translation: This is because, in DQ7, conversations generally take place when the player talks to a companion. Scenes in which companions spontaneously converse with one another as part of the story are extremely limited.

blocks.source: ほとんどの会話は主人公と仲間の一対一で行われるため、主人公が置き去りにされることはほとんどない。
blocks.translation: Since most conversations are one-on-one between the protagonist and a companion, the protagonist is rarely left out.

blocks.source: ともあれ、前述した配慮のためにゲーム制作者が払うべきコストは馬鹿にならない。ペルソナシリーズの膨大な交流イベントがその典型だ。難しいようなら、無口主人公は避けたほうが無難だろう。
blocks.translation: In any case, the cost game creators must pay to provide the aforementioned considerations is substantial. The Persona series' enormous number of interaction events is a typical example. If it seems too difficult, it would probably be safer to avoid using a silent protagonist.

blocks.source: かくいう筆者も宗旨替えをした側である。仲間を魅力的に描こうとすればするほど、この問題に突き当たるようになってしまったという理由が大きい。
blocks.translation: I, too, am someone who changed my stance. The main reason is that the more I tried to portray the companions compellingly, the more I found myself running into this problem.

blocks.source: どちらかというと、無口主人公はテキスト量が少なく、仲間がほとんど喋らない作品に向いたスタイルだと思う。
blocks.translation: If anything, I think silent protagonists are a style better suited to works with little text and companions who rarely speak.

blocks.source: あるいは、ＤＱ７のように仲間との対話が基本となる作品ならば、比較的に相性がよいだろうか。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, they may be relatively well suited to works like DQ7, where conversations with companions are the foundation.

parts.source: 無口主人公における技法
無口主人公の向き不向き

lines.source: これは前回（[[LINK_1]]主人公と仲間の構成[[/LINK_1]]）と重なるが、無口主人公の存在感を出すため、どうあがいても他のキャラクターでは敵わないような『主人公特権』を与える。

parts.source: ）と重なるが、無口主人公の存在感を出すため、どうあがいても他のキャラクターでは敵わないような『主人公特権』を与える。

lines.translation: This overlaps with the previous installment ([[LINK_1]]Protagonist and Companion Composition[[/LINK_1]]), but to give the silent protagonist a strong presence, grant them a “protagonist privilege” that makes it impossible for any other character to match them, no matter how hard they try.
[[LINK_1]]>Return to the RPG Design Guides Table of Contents[[/LINK_1]]

texts.『無口主人公』とは喋らず、セリフの無い主人公のことである。これはＤＱシリーズを始: A “silent protagonist” is a protagonist who does not speak and has no lines. This is a classic protagonist format used in many RPGs, beginning with the Dragon Quest series. This time, I would like to examine the silent protagonist.
texts.セリフがないからといって、必ずしも没個性とは限らないことに注意して欲しい。また、: Please note that having no lines does not necessarily mean lacking individuality. Also, the contents of dialogue choices are not always without lines. The overall atmosphere changes considerably depending on whether the party members have distinct personalities.
texts.無口主人公の作品例: Examples of Works with Silent Protagonists
texts.参考に無口主人公の作品例を挙げてみよう。: For reference, let us look at some examples of works with silent protagonists.
texts.主人公も仲間にも全くといってよいほど個性や背景が設定されておらず、名前・職業等も: Neither the protagonist nor the party members have any real individuality or background established, and even their names and classes can be chosen by the player. They are ostensibly adventurers who have come to explore a dungeon, but they can be said to have almost no individuality at all.
texts.ＤＱ１の時代は、主人公には『勇者の子孫』といった最低限の背景が設定されているだけ: In the era of Dragon Quest I, the protagonist had only a minimal background, such as being a “descendant of the Luminary.” The player could choose only the protagonist’s name.
texts.ＤＱ２では、仲間が追加されたが、セリフは控えめであり、主人公の個性を浮かび上がら: In Dragon Quest II, party members were added, but their lines were restrained and did not bring the protagonist’s individuality to the forefront.
texts.ＤＱ３に至って、徐々に主人公の背景が濃くなってくる。『英雄の息子』として、主人公: By Dragon Quest III, the protagonist’s background gradually became more substantial. The protagonist sets out on a journey as the “son of a hero,” and this setting is put to use toward the end of the game. Since the party members also basically do not speak, there are no exchanges with the protagonist. Their individuality is left almost entirely to the player’s imagination.
texts.ＦＣ版のカンダタ２戦目のイベントで、主人公（正確には先頭のキャラ）が喋るのは黒歴: The protagonist (more precisely, the character in the lead position) speaking during the second encounter with Kandar in the Famicom version is best left in the series’ dark history.
texts.ＤＱ４では『育った村を魔族に滅ぼされた悲劇の勇者』として、主人公は旅立つことにな: In Dragon Quest IV, the protagonist sets out on a journey as “a tragic Luminary whose hometown was destroyed by demons.”
texts.ＤＱ５では主人公の出生や結婚等、自身の人生が物語の中心に据えられている。セリフこ: In Dragon Quest V, the protagonist’s own life—including their birth and marriage—is placed at the center of the story. Although the protagonist has no lines, it is clear that they are established as a fully realized character with a definite background.
texts.シリーズが進むに連れて、個性的な仲間達も主人公に関わってくるようになる。: As the series progresses, distinctive party members also become increasingly involved with the protagonist.
texts.特にＤＱ７の『マリベル』は主人公に対して話しかけることが多く、主人公も人間関係の: In particular, Maribel in Dragon Quest VII often speaks to the protagonist, making it clear that the protagonist is also part of the circle of relationships.
texts.ＤＱ８の『ヤンガス』に至っては、主人公に命を助けられたことをきっかけに主人公を兄: By the time of Yangus in Dragon Quest VIII, he comes to look up to the protagonist as an older-brother figure after the protagonist saves his life.
texts.ＤＱ９では、仲間が喋らない等、ＤＱ３の頃に近い雰囲気に戻る。主人公の職業や容姿が: In Dragon Quest IX, the series returns to an atmosphere closer to that of Dragon Quest III, with party members who do not speak and so on. Allowing the player to customize the protagonist’s class and appearance emphasizes the structure of “the protagonist = the player” more strongly than ever.
texts.シリーズを通して、選択肢の内容が『はい』『いいえ』に限られていることも、特徴とし: One feature of the series that should not be overlooked is that the choices are limited to “Yes” and “No.” However, if the protagonist continues to be given individuality along the lines of Dragon Quest VIII, I personally suspect that this traditional choice system is nearing its limit.
texts.無口主人公としては、最も個性的なのが、このペルソナシリーズ。元々、源流の女神転生: Of all silent protagonists, the Persona series has perhaps the most individuality. Originally, in the Megami Tensei series from which it evolved, silent protagonists with no individuality were the norm. The Persona series inherited the silent protagonist, but not the lack of individuality.
texts.選択肢に特徴を持たせて、個性を強調したり、仲間から好意や信頼を寄せられたりと、随: The choices are distinctive, emphasizing the protagonist’s individuality, while the protagonist also earns the affection and trust of their companions, creating a strong presence throughout the game. Another characteristic is the cool personality conveyed through the protagonist’s appearance, choice contents, and conversations with companions. Depending on the title, even the protagonist’s first-person pronoun (usually “ore”) and mannerisms may be established.
texts.ペルソナ２罪では、主人公『周防達哉』は過去の出来事から無口な性格になったと説明さ: In Persona 2: Innocent Sin, it is explained that the protagonist, Tatsuya Suou, became taciturn because of events in the past. In its sequel, Persona 2: Eternal Punishment, the protagonist changes, and Tatsuya is demoted (?) to a speaking party member; instead, Maya Amano, who had been the heroine figure in the previous game, becomes the silent protagonist. Maya had an energetic personality in the previous game, so the change feels extremely strange.
texts.ペルソナ３では「どうでもいい」、４では「落ち着け」というように、選択肢の中に頻出: Some choices appear frequently, such as “Whatever” in Persona 3 and “Calm down” in Persona 4. These can also be interpreted as the protagonist’s verbal habits.
texts.ポケモン、女神転生、マザー、ＦＥ風花雪月、ブレスオブファイア１～４、幻想水滸伝、: Pokémon, Megami Tensei, MOTHER, Fire Emblem: Three Houses, Breath of Fire I–IV, Suikoden, Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Legend of Mana, Bahamut Lagoon, Wild Arms I, Momotaro Dentetsu, The Great Battle of the Shell Monsters, Glory of Hercules, and so on.
texts.全体的な傾向として、シリーズが進む毎に、無口主人公であっても、個性や設定背景が濃: As a general trend, even when protagonists remain silent, their individuality and established backgrounds tend to become more substantial with each installment. In some cases, such as Breath of Fire and Wild Arms, the protagonist even becomes a speaking character in later titles.
texts.『キャラクターとしての主人公』に余計なセリフを喋らせないことで、『主人公＝プレイ: By not having the “protagonist as a character” speak unnecessary lines, the game emphasizes that “the protagonist = the player” and increases immersion. It also avoids situations in which the protagonist says or does something the player would never think or do, hindering immersion.
texts.主人公が喋らないことによって、会話が短くなりテンポが良くなる事も重要な長所だ。主: Another important advantage is that having the protagonist remain silent shortens conversations and improves the pacing. This is especially noticeable in works where neither the protagonist nor the party members speak at all.
texts.また、主人公に喋らせないことで、仲間の個性を強調する効果がある。シナリオ重視の作: Having the protagonist remain silent also emphasizes the individuality of the party members. This is effective in story-focused works that aim to convey the appeal of the companions to the player.
texts.逆転の発想で、無口であること自体を主人公の個性として差別化することもできる。なん: As a reversal of this idea, the protagonist’s silence itself can be used to differentiate them as an individual. After all, no matter how many characters a story has, it is highly unlikely that another character will share exactly the same personality.
texts.その特性上、無口主人公は自分の発言によって物語を牽引することはできない。例えば「: By their nature, silent protagonists cannot drive the story through their own words. For example, they cannot tell the player the objective by saying something like, “The world will be destroyed unless we defeat the Demon King. So we’ll defeat him ourselves!”
texts.他の仲間に同様の発言をさせるか、王様などの登場人物から「魔王を倒してくれ！」とい: Another party member must say something similar, or a character such as a king must give them an instruction like, “Please defeat the Demon King!”
texts.そのため、主人公でありながら、他の仲間に同調したり、指示を受けたりする形で行動し: As a result, despite being the protagonist, they tend to act by going along with the other party members or following instructions. Naturally, more events arise that can be derisively described as “fetch quests.”
texts.また、ＤＱ３や９のように仲間も一切喋らない作品なら大きな問題はない。が、そうでな: There is no major problem in works like Dragon Quest III and IX, where the party members do not speak at all. Otherwise, however, the party members may have many conversations among themselves as the story progresses. If the protagonist is excluded from the group as a result, their presence fades, and they end up being derisively called a “background protagonist.”
texts.無口主人公とは相性の悪い主人公設定・物語があることも考慮しなくてはならない。例え: One must also consider that some protagonist settings and stories do not work well with a silent protagonist. For example, this could be a story in which the protagonist is a veteran warrior and many acquaintances from their past appear.
texts.物語中盤で初登場した人物に、いきなり知り合いであるかのように声をかけられたら、「: If someone appearing for the first time halfway through the story suddenly addresses the protagonist as though they already know each other, players who had been assuming “the protagonist = me” might be confused.
texts.無口主人公には大きな長所があるが、同時に大きな短所も存在することが分かったと思う: I hope it is now clear that silent protagonists have major advantages, but also major disadvantages. Therefore, I would like to consider ways to move the story forward effectively and give the protagonist a strong presence even while keeping them silent, thereby compensating for these disadvantages.
texts.先に書いた通り『歴戦の戦士』などの濃い人物設定と無口主人公とは相性が悪い。そのた: As I mentioned earlier, a strong character setting such as “veteran warrior” does not work well with a silent protagonist. Therefore, at the beginning of the story, it is necessary to give the protagonist a background that is as unrestrictive as possible. This is why protagonists are often young people in their late teens.
texts.また、色が付かないという意味では、記憶喪失の設定とも相性がよく、合わせて使用され: In the sense that it leaves the character undefined, amnesia also works well with a silent protagonist and is often used in combination with one (as in the Glory of Hercules series, among others).
texts.強大な能力。世界の命運を左右するような物でも。: Powerful abilities—even ones capable of determining the fate of the world.
texts.地位。国王・王子、伝説の勇者など。: Status, such as being a king, prince, or legendary Luminary.
texts.関係性。ヒロインやラスボス等の主要人物と強固な因縁を設定する。: Relationships. Establish strong connections with key characters such as the heroine and final boss.
texts.幻想水滸伝１～２では、主人公が成り行きで『強大な紋章の力』を手に入れたあげく、『: In Suikoden I–II, the protagonist happens to acquire the power of a powerful Rune and is then elevated to the position of military leader. This sequence of events unfolds early in the story. Giving the protagonist privileges such as powerful abilities and status helps establish their presence.
texts.先に述べた通り、無口主人公は自分の発言によって物語を牽引することはできない。: As mentioned earlier, a silent protagonist cannot drive the story through their own dialogue.
texts.そのため、単なる村人のような設定では「なぜ、主人公が強大なラスボスと戦うのか？」: Therefore, with a setting in which the protagonist is merely an ordinary villager, it is difficult to smoothly convey to the player the motivation behind questions such as, “Why is the protagonist fighting the powerful final boss?” Give the protagonist the kinds of privileges described above to make the premise more convincing.
texts.ラスボスを倒すには、主人公が持つ特殊能力が必要。: The protagonist’s special ability is necessary to defeat the final boss.
texts.主人公は王子として、自国を脅かすラスボスと戦う。: As a prince, the protagonist fights the final boss threatening their country.
texts.幼馴染のヒロインを助けるには、ラスボスを倒さなければならない。: The protagonist must defeat the final boss to save their childhood friend, the heroine.
texts.選択肢を掲示することで、主人公が会話に参加しているという空気を出す。選択肢に応じ: Presenting choices creates the impression that the protagonist is participating in the conversation. The key is what changes occur depending on the choice. Sometimes only the dialogue changes, while in other cases the choice may have a major impact on later developments.
texts.「はい」「いいえ」の様に無個性なものを用いるか、ペルソナシリーズの様に個性的な選: The impression of the protagonist changes depending on whether you use impersonal choices such as “Yes” and “No” or provide distinctive choices like those in the Persona series. Come up with choices that suit your game.
texts.好感度システムのようなものを採用する作品も多いが、ギャルゲーチックになるのが好き: Many games adopt systems such as an affinity system, but whether the result feels too much like a dating sim is a matter of personal preference. Decide what to do based on the game’s themes.
texts.無口主人公だからといって、常にイベント中、無反応で棒立ちでは、違和感を拭い切れな: Even for a silent protagonist, it feels unnatural if they simply stand there without reacting throughout every event. Above all, they end up seeming like someone who could just as well not be there.
texts.そこで「頷く」「首を振る」「手を振る」等のジェスチャーや「！」「…」「♪」等の感: Use gestures such as nodding, shaking their head, and waving, as well as emotional symbols such as “!”, “…”, and “♪”, so that the protagonist does not get left behind. Giving them at least minimal reactions also helps keep the story moving smoothly.
texts.例えば、「仲間の命が危ない！ 助けよう！」というような会話において、常識的に考え: For example, in a conversation like “Our friend’s life is in danger! Let’s save them!”, it would be inconceivable for the protagonist to take a negative attitude from a common-sense perspective.
texts.このように「選択肢を掲示したくない」あるいは「するまでもない」場合は「頷く」の動: In cases where you do not want to present a choice, or where one is unnecessary, have the protagonist automatically agree through a nod. This lets the conversation move along more smoothly than presenting a choice.
texts.物語としては、ある程度、無口主人公にも自発的に行動してもらわなければ進まない。ジ: As a story, the game cannot progress unless the silent protagonist takes some initiative. If gestures and emotional symbols are not enough, have them act more proactively.
texts.例としては、前述したＤＱ８における、主人公がヤンガスを助ける回想シーンが挙げられ: One example is the flashback scene in DQ8 mentioned earlier, in which the protagonist saves Yangus. The scene proceeds as follows.
texts.当時、山賊をしていたヤンガスが、主人公とその主トロデに対して脅迫を行う。: Yangus, who was a bandit at the time, threatens the protagonist and their master, Trode.
texts.ヤンガスは武器を振り回すが、足元の吊橋を壊し、崖の下に落ちそうになる。: Yangus swings his weapon around, breaks the suspension bridge beneath him, and nearly falls off the cliff.
texts.トロデは、ヤンガスを見捨てるように言う。: Trode tells the protagonist to abandon Yangus.
texts.しかし、それを無視して主人公はヤンガスを助ける。: However, the protagonist ignores him and saves Yangus.
texts.これは『主人公＝プレイヤー』の等式を徹底するＤＱシリーズとしては異例の展開である: This is an unusual development for the Dragon Quest series, which consistently follows the equation “the protagonist = the player.” It is rare for the protagonist to act so voluntarily, and I personally found it very interesting.
texts.一連の流れの中で主人公は表情の変化こそあるものの、当然セリフは発しない。プレイヤ: Although the protagonist’s expression changes during this sequence of events, they naturally do not speak a single line. Without involving the player’s will at all, they decide to save Yangus and put that decision into action.
texts.このように無口主人公に対して、自発的に行動させてしまうのも１つの手だ。ただし、余: Having a silent protagonist act voluntarily in this way is one possible approach. However, if you make them act too arbitrarily, the player may lose their connection with the character. Try to have them take common-sense, morally sound actions, such as helping someone, so that the player can accept their decisions.
texts.無口主人公の作品において、ストーリー進行を円滑に行うには『相棒』を作る方法がある: In a game with a silent protagonist, one way to keep the story moving smoothly is to create a “partner.” Here, a partner refers to a character whose role is to speak lines in place of the silent protagonist.
texts.「アイツ 何て悪い奴なんだ！ 俺達で懲らしめてやろうぜ！」というような感想を述べ: Guide the player’s actions by having the partner make comments such as, “What a terrible person! Let’s teach them a lesson!”
texts.また「わっ！ 虫眼鏡で太陽を見てはいけないって学校で習ったでしょう。ボス！」とい: Another role is to react to the protagonist’s actions and choices, saying things like, “Whoa! You learned at school not to look at the sun through a magnifying glass, remember? Boss!”
texts.ポイントは主人公に対して、語りかけるような口調にすること。主人公の意向を形だけで: The key is to have the partner speak as though addressing the protagonist. Even if only in form, asking about the protagonist’s wishes helps prevent their presence from fading into the background.
texts.相棒は物語の大半において、主人公に同行するキャラクターである必要がある。ＤＱ９の: For most of the story, the partner needs to be a character who accompanies the protagonist. They do not necessarily need to participate in battles, as with Sandy from DQ9 or Koppa from Shiren the Wanderer.
texts.また、必ずしも特定の１人である必要はない。主人公との関係性から、上記のような反応: The partner does not necessarily have to be one specific person, either. Any character whose relationship with the protagonist makes the kinds of reactions described above feel natural will work.
texts.仲間や敵に主人公を意識させる: Make Allies and Enemies Pay Attention to the Protagonist
texts.「仲間同士の会話」「仲間と敵との会話」に置き去りにされた結果、主人公の存在感が希: The protagonist’s presence can fade into the background as a result of being left out of conversations between allies or conversations between allies and enemies. This is a major challenge with silent protagonists. The stronger the personalities of the allies, the greater this concern becomes.
texts.そこで、主人公に対して『好意』『親愛』『敵視』等、何らかの形で強い意識を向けるキ: Try creating characters who show the protagonist strong interest in some way, such as affection, fondness, or hostility. This brings the protagonist into the story’s circle and helps establish their presence.
texts.主人公に好意を向けるヒロイン。: A heroine who has feelings for the protagonist.
texts.主人公を兄貴として慕う、弟分・妹分キャラ。実の弟妹も当然ＯＫ。: A younger-brother or younger-sister type who looks up to the protagonist as an older brother. Actual younger siblings work too, of course.
texts.主人公を主君と仰ぐ召し使い。: A servant who reveres the protagonist as their lord.
texts.主人公を頼りにする親友。: A close friend who relies on the protagonist.
texts.主人公をライバル視する敵キャラ。: An enemy who regards the protagonist as a rival.
texts.『相棒』と兼業させるのもオススメの方法だ。: Having this character also serve as the “partner” is another recommended approach.
texts.主人公の株を奪うキャラクターを作らない: Do Not Create Characters Who Steal the Protagonist’s Spotlight
texts.これは後ろ向きの発想になるが、主人公の株を奪いかねないようなキャラクターは最初か: This is a somewhat negative approach, but simply avoid creating characters from the outset who might steal the protagonist’s spotlight.
texts.主人公の立場をおびやかすようなキャラクターの特徴。: Characteristics of characters who threaten the protagonist’s position.
texts.主人公と性別が同じ。: The same gender as the protagonist.
texts.身分、立場、年齢等が主人公より上。: Higher in status, position, age, or similar respects than the protagonist.
texts.主人公以上にストーリーの根幹に関わる設定を持つ。: Has a backstory that is even more central to the story than the protagonist's.
texts.モテる。特に主人公よりも、ヒロインと仲が良いと鉄板。: Popular. In particular, having a closer relationship with the heroine than the protagonist does is a sure formula.
texts.以上のような特徴を多く併せ持つキャラクターは、主人公の株を奪いかねない。というか: A character who combines many of the above traits may end up stealing the protagonist's spotlight. In fact, if you're going to create such a character, they should probably be the protagonist instead. It's perfectly fine to have characters who possess some of these traits, but give them some kind of flaw so they don't take the central role in the party.
texts.物語の目的に関わる重要人物だが、性格はヘタレ。: An important character involved in the story's objective, but a coward at heart.
texts.切れ者だが、偏屈で人当たりが悪い。: Sharp-witted, but eccentric and unpleasant to be around.
texts.行動力はあるが、無鉄砲で失敗も多い。: Full of initiative, but reckless and often unsuccessful.
texts.途中で裏切ったり離脱したりする。: Betrays the party or leaves it partway through.
texts.これは無口主人公に限らず、主人公全般にも言えることでもある。ＦＦ１２における『ヴ: This applies not only to silent protagonists, but to protagonists in general. Ashe and Balthier in relation to Vaan in FF12 are classic examples. Since silent protagonists have fewer opportunities to assert themselves, you need to be especially careful.
texts.作風によって、無口主人公には向き不向きがある。: Depending on the style of the work, silent protagonists may or may not be a good fit.
texts.特に注意したいのは、無口主人公かつ仲間がよく喋る作品だ。: Particular caution is needed for works with a silent protagonist and highly talkative companions.
texts.仲間同士の会話中心で物語が進んでしまうと、主人公の存在価値が疑わしくなってしまう: If the story progresses mainly through conversations between companions, the protagonist's value and purpose may come into question.
texts.ＤＱ１１やペルソナシリーズ、ＦＥ風花雪月といった作品を観察してみると、無口主人公: If you examine works such as DQ11, the Persona series, and FE: Three Houses, you'll see that they take considerable care to highlight their silent protagonists.
texts.主人公を唯一無二の選ばれし者にしたり、仲間との一対一の交流イベントを用意したり、: They use every method imaginable to build up the protagonist: making them the one-and-only chosen one, providing one-on-one interaction events with companions, and even introducing romantic elements.
texts.なお、仲間がよく喋るという点ではＤＱ７も同じだが、あちらは大きな問題にはならない: DQ7 also has highly talkative companions, but it doesn't become a major problem.
texts.ＤＱ７では原則、プレイヤーが仲間に話しかけることで会話をする仕組みになっているか: This is because, in DQ7, conversations generally take place when the player talks to a companion. Scenes in which companions spontaneously converse with one another as part of the story are extremely limited.
texts.ほとんどの会話は主人公と仲間の一対一で行われるため、主人公が置き去りにされること: Since most conversations are one-on-one between the protagonist and a companion, the protagonist is rarely left out.
texts.ともあれ、前述した配慮のためにゲーム制作者が払うべきコストは馬鹿にならない。ペル: In any case, the cost game creators must pay to provide the aforementioned considerations is substantial. The Persona series' enormous number of interaction events is a typical example. If it seems too difficult, it would probably be safer to avoid using a silent protagonist.
texts.かくいう筆者も宗旨替えをした側である。仲間を魅力的に描こうとすればするほど、この: I, too, am someone who changed my stance. The main reason is that the more I tried to portray the companions compellingly, the more I found myself running into this problem.
texts.どちらかというと、無口主人公はテキスト量が少なく、仲間がほとんど喋らない作品に向: If anything, I think silent protagonists are a style better suited to works with little text and companions who rarely speak.
texts.あるいは、ＤＱ７のように仲間との対話が基本となる作品ならば、比較的に相性がよいだ: Alternatively, they may be relatively well suited to works like DQ7, where conversations with companions are the foundation.
